semanticConstraints: Local literal presentation paths cannot overlap native authentication/API/control prefixes. Native CShells rejects route collisions before generation publication.
Native LogoutLandingPath must equal RoutePrefix plus /signed-out. BFF browser actions reuse native authentication and antiforgery.
Application name, locale and bounded copy are encoded as text. Only known copy keys are accepted.
